value.body: The Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) is a two-year teacher-training course for people who already hold a degree. It prepares you to teach physical education in schools and covers teaching methods, sports training, officiating, health education and practice teaching. It is recognised by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE).

items.label: Course length
items.note: Lengthened from one year under the NCTE 2014 regulations

items.label: Who can apply
items.value: Graduates who meet NCTE conditions on marks and sports participation or physical education subjects

value.title: How you get in
value.body: University or state entrance tests, usually combined with a physical fitness test and sometimes a sports skill test. Many states run a common B.P.Ed entrance; check the university's prospectus for marks, age and sports-certificate rules.

value.title: At a glance
items: It is the usual qualification asked for physical education teacher posts in schools.
An M.P.Ed is the next step for college teaching and coaching-education roles.
Check NCTE recognition of the college before joining.

value.title: B.P.Ed enrolment by year
value.note: Based on institutions that responded to the survey; part of the year-to-year change reflects response coverage.
value.source: AISHE 2021-22 to 2023-24, all modes (Ministry of Education)
